rules: root protocol value 0 denotes anchor protocol:0
root protocol value 1 denotes anchor protocol:1
exactly two direct protocol atoms ab denote one ordered Link(a,b)
root boundary aliases use their accepted projected protocol value
all other root carriers remain raw in this subset

canonicalInverse.singlePair: concatenate canonical start and end protocol atoms

evidence.sequenceRule: an achislo implicitly starts at ∞; deserializing ∞ab produces a⟼b while the loaded sequence itself does not contain a⟼b
evidence.scopeDecision: apply that rule only where both a and b are already accepted direct protocol atoms 0/1
